ta_doc:
Signals are computed on daily closes (adjusted). Trend: Uptrend = close > SMA50 > SMA200; Downtrend = close < SMA50 < SMA200; otherwise Mixed.
Golden/Death cross = SMA50 crossing above/below SMA200 within the last 5 sessions. RSI14 uses Wilder smoothing (flag >70 overbought, <30 oversold).
MACD(12,26,9) cross = MACD line crossing its signal line within the last 3 sessions. 20D breakout/breakdown = close above/below the highest/lowest close of the prior 20 sessions.
Basket indices: equal-weighted, daily-rebalanced (average of constituents' daily returns) on the US (SPY) trading calendar, ~2y history, rebased to 100 one year (252 sessions) ago.

questions.title: Making new highs
questions.rule: Close at a new 52-week closing high, or within 2% of the 52-week intraday high (252 sessions). 20-day closing highs listed separately (info only).

questions.title: Holding the 8/21 trend
questions.rule: Close > 8-day EMA > 21-day EMA, and the 8-day EMA rising vs the prior session.

questions.title: Outperforming SPY / QQQ
questions.rule: Both the 1M (21-session) and 3M (63-session) returns beat both SPY and QQQ.

questions.title: Relative strength
questions.rule: RS line (close / SPY) at a new 63-session high, OR RS rating >= 80 (top 20%). RS rating = percentile (1-99) within this universe of 0.4*3M + 0.2*6M + 0.2*9M + 0.2*12M return (IBD-style); needs 252 sessions.

questions.title: Breaking out of a base
questions.rule: Close above the high of a 15-65 session consolidation whose (high-low)/high <= 15%, with the breakout today or within the last 3 sessions, and the latest close still above that base high.

questions.title: Volume expanding
questions.rule: Either (a) latest volume >= 1.5x the prior 50-session average on an up day, or (b) 10-session average volume > 50-session average AND up days carried more volume than down days over those 10 sessions (accumulation), unless the latest session was heavy-volume selling. Heavy volume on a down day is listed separately as selling, not a pass.

checklist.note: Universe = all priced theme tickers (unique Yahoo symbols). Non-US tickers use local-exchange prices/volume in local currency and are still compared with SPY/QQQ (currency effects not removed). Adjusted OHLCV from Yahoo Finance.

options.doc: Universe: US-listed theme stocks priced >= $10 (options liquidity). CALL screen: passes >= 3 of the 6 checklist items, close above a rising 21-day EMA (EMA21 higher than 5 sessions ago) and above the 50-day SMA, RSI14 between 50 and 72 (not overextended). Ranked by checklist count, then RS rating. Trigger = break above the 5-session intraday high (or hold above base pivot); stop = daily close below the 21-day EMA (or the 50-day SMA if that is higher). PUT screen: US-listed, close below the 8- and 21-day EMAs (8 below 21) and below the 50-day SMA, RSI14 above 30 (not oversold), lagging SPY and QQQ over 1M and 3M, plus at least 2 of: RS rating <= 40, 20-day closing breakdown, MACD histogram negative, heavy-volume selling (>=1.5x on a down day) or down-day volume > up-day volume over 10 sessions. Ranked with stops within 12% of price first (workable risk), then weakness count, then RSI >= 35 (room to fall), then lowest RS. Trigger = break below the 5-session intraday low; stop = daily close above the 21-day EMA (or the 50-day SMA if that is lower and still above price). Max 5 each; fewer are shown when fewer qualify. Check option liquidity, IV and earnings dates before any trade.
